paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Comparison of the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth vs. generated answers: Pop_GT vs. Pop_Ge, and RPop_GT vs. RPop_Ge.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart compares the correlation between ChatGPT's question-answering performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categorical variables, with labels for each category placed below the respective groups of bars. The vertical axis, labeled "Correlation," ranges from 0 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1 and is scaled linearly. Four distinct data series are represented by differently styled bars: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (hatched orange), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (hatched blue), as indicated by the legend in the upper right corner. For each category, four bars are displayed side-by-side, showing the correlation values for the respective series. In the "Movies" category, the highest correlation is observed for RPop_Ge, followed by RPop_GT, Pop_GT, and Pop_Ge. In the "Songs" category, RPop_Ge shows the highest correlation, followed by RPop_GT, Pop_GT, and Pop_Ge. In the "Basketball" category, RPop_Ge has the highest correlation, followed by RPop_GT, Pop_Ge, and Pop_GT. The bars are arranged in the order of the categories on the x-axis, and the chart uses distinct patterns and colors to differentiate the data series without any visual emphasis on specific bars.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart compares the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three domains—Movies, Songs, and Basketball—using two metrics: Pop_GT vs. Pop_Ge and RPop_GT vs. RPop_Ge. The vertical axis represents correlation values ranging from 0 to 0.7, while the horizontal axis lists the three categories. For each category, two pairs of bars are shown: one for Pop_GT (orange, solid fill) and Pop_Ge (light orange, hatched fill), and another for RPop_GT (blue, solid fill) and RPop_Ge (blue, diagonally hatched fill). In the Movies category, Pop_GT has a correlation of approximately 0.23, Pop_Ge is around 0.1, RPop_GT is about 0.35, and RPop_Ge reaches 0.63. In Songs, Pop_GT is approximately 0.3, Pop_Ge is 0.1, RPop_GT is around 0.48, and RPop_Ge peaks at 0.68. In Basketball, Pop_GT is about 0.08, Pop_Ge is 0.09, RPop_GT is approximately 0.12, and RPop_Ge is around 0.22. The legend in the top-right corner identifies the four bar types. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing two pairs of bars, and the RPop_Ge bars are consistently the tallest within each group, indicating the highest correlation values.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt den Vergleich der Korrelation zwischen der Frage-Antwort-Leistung von ChatGPT und den Grundwahrheiten sowie den generierten Antworten für drei Kategorien: Movies, Songs und Basketball. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Kategorien dar, die in alphabetischer Reihenfolge angeordnet sind, während die vertikale Achse die Korrelation mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 0.7 in Schritten von 0.1 anzeigt. Es werden vier verschiedene Balkengruppen dargestellt, die jeweils durch unterschiedliche Muster und Farben kodiert sind: Pop_GT (orange mit diagonalen Strichen), Pop_Ge (orange mit diagonalen Strichen und kleineren diagonalen Linien), RPop_GT (dunkelblau mit diagonalen Strichen) und RPop_Ge (hellblau mit diagonalen Strichen). Für jede Kategorie sind vier Balken gruppiert, wobei die Balken innerhalb jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet sind. Die Balkenlängen variieren je nach Kategorie und Gruppe; beispielsweise ist der höchste Balken im Bereich „Songs“ der RPop_Ge-Balken mit einer ungefähren Korrelation von 0.7, während der niedrigste Balken im Bereich „Basketball“ der Pop_Ge-Balken mit einer ungefähren Korrelation von 0.1 liegt. Die Balken sind nicht nach Höhe sortiert, sondern nach Kategorien gruppiert, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck. Die Legende rechts oben ordnet die Farben und Muster den jeweiligen Gruppen zu.
